thag6.3:1.1: thero. Yassa sabrahmacārīsu gāravo n' ūpalabbhati, parihāyati saddhammā maccho appodake yathā. || ||
thag6.3:2.1: yassa sabrahmacārīsu . . . na virūhati saddhamme khette bījaṃ va pūtikaṃ. || ||
thag6.3:3.1: yassa sabrahmacārīsu . . . ārakā hoti nibbānā dhammarājassa sāsane. || ||
thag6.3:4.1: yassa sabrahmacārīsu gāravo upalabbhati, na vihāyati saddhammā maccho bavhodake yathā. || ||
thag6.3:5.1: yassa . . . so virūhati saddhamme khette bījaṃ va bhaddakaṃ. || ||
thag6.3:6.1: yassa . . . santike hoti nibbānaṃ dhammarājassa sāsane 'ti. || || Mahānāgo thero.
